description:
**We're looking for a**
****Software Engineer****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Job Title:**
Software Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
**3- 4 years of hands-on software engineering experience**
, building and operating production systems
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a
**Software Engineer**
to design, build, and scale high-quality software systems that power our product platforms. This role is ideal for a strong, hands-on engineer with solid backend fundamentals, cloud experience, and growing exposure to AI-driven development.
  
  
The ideal candidate has
**strong experience with Java and AWS**
, good experience working on
**React**
, a good understanding of
**SQL and NoSQL data stores**
, and an interest or hands-on experience integrating
**AI or Generative AI capabilities**
into real-world applications. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that drive customer value.
  
  
****In this role you will...****
**Software Development & System Design**

* Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs using Java and modern frameworks.
* Build and operate cloud-native services on AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Develop and expose API-first services using REST and GraphQL.
* Contribute to system design discussions and help implement scalable, distributed architectures.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code following engineering best practices.
* Design and implement application UI using React, Typescript

**Data & Platform Engineering**

* Design and work with SQL and NoSQL databases to support high-scale application workloads.
* Implement data access patterns with a focus on performance, reliability, and consistency.
* Contribute to event-driven and asynchronous processing where appropriate.

**AI-Aware Development**

* Integrate AI or ML capabilities into applications, including LLM-based features or intelligent automation.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and architects on AI-enabled system designs.
* Apply best practices for using AI services safely, reliably, and cost-effectively.

**Cloud, DevOps & Quality**

* Deploy and operate services on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure automation.
* Monitor, debug, and optimize production systems.
* Partner with QA, DevOps, and Security teams to ensure quality and compliance.

**Collaboration & Growth**

* Work closely with Product Managers, UX designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver customer-facing features.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute positively to team culture.

****You’ve got what it takes if you have…****
**Required**

* 3- 4 years of hands-on software engineering experience building production systems.
* Strong experience with Java in backend and service-oriented architectures.
* Strong experience with React, Typescript and frontend development
* Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.).
* Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production.
* Experience building RESTful APIs; exposure to GraphQL is a plus.
* Experience with Docker; exposure to Kubernetes (EKS) is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a quality-first mindset.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to AI or Generative AI in production systems.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React).
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK).
* Experience working in agile, product-driven environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Strong Engineering Culture: Build well-architected, high-quality systems.
* Growth Path: Clear progression toward Staff, Principal, or AI-focused roles.
* Modern Stack: Java, AWS, Kubernetes, SQL/NoSQL, and AI-enabled services.
* Collaboration: Work with talented engineers, product leaders, and designers.
* Core Values: Be part of a company that lives by Shattering Boundaries, Sparking Greatness, and Sharing Success.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million+ users in 180+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high-performing, future-ready organizations and people today.

title: AI Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Medhavya Systems is an innovative technology company specializing in intelligent software solutions, AI-powered applications, ERP systems, and business automation platforms. The company supports businesses across diverse industries through digital transformation and customized software development. Its key services include AI and automation solutions, sector-specific ERP platforms for agriculture, education, healthcare, logistics, and transport, as well as business intelligence and data analytics. Medhavya Systems also delivers custom web and mobile applications tailored to client requirements. The company’s vision is to make advanced technology accessible to businesses across India, helping them grow smarter, faster, and more efficiently.
  
**Role Description**
The AI Intern role at Medhavya Systems is a full-time, on-site position based in Solapur. The intern will assist in designing, implementing, and testing AI and machine learning models for real-world business applications. Daily responsibilities include data collection and preprocessing, model training and evaluation, and collaborating with senior engineers to integrate AI modules into existing software systems. The intern will also support documentation, create simple prototypes or proof-of-concept solutions, and participate in code reviews and technical discussions. This role offers hands-on experience with production-oriented AI projects and exposure to modern tools and frameworks in a collaborative environment.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess foundational knowledge in Computer Science and strong Analytical Skills for problem-solving and system design.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Science and Machine Learning to work with datasets, build models, and derive insights.
* Candidates should possess Programming skills (e.g., Python, Java, or similar) to implement algorithms, write clean code, and work with AI libraries.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with AI/ML tools and frameworks (such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn) and basic understanding of data structures and algorithms.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills, the ability to work collaboratively, eagerness to learn, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; prior internship or project experience in AI or software development is an advantage.

title: UAV Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Protthapan (प्रोत्थापन) Technologies is a next-generation defense technology and enterprise solutions company focused on indigenous, intelligent systems for India’s armed forces and industrial sectors. The organization specializes in AI-powered software, autonomous drones, unmanned ground vehicles, and real-time decision support solutions for strategic applications. Core capabilities include defense-grade AI and NLP software, UAV and UGV autonomy, ground control station solutions, embedded hardware, sensor fusion, and swarm intelligence frameworks. Protthapan collaborates with the Indian Armed Forces, disaster response and border patrol units, defense R&D organizations, and enterprises exploring automation and robotics. The company’s vision is to build resilient systems that serve and protect, and invites collaborators to help shape the future of defense and innovation.
  
**Role Description**
The UAV Engineer will design, develop, integrate, and test unmanned aerial vehicle platforms and subsystems for defense and enterprise applications. Day-to-day responsibilities include working on airframe design, propulsion and power systems, avionics integration, flight control algorithms, and payload configurations, while ensuring performance, safety, and reliability standards are met. The role involves collaborating closely with AI, embedded systems, and software teams to implement autonomy, mission planning, and communication capabilities, as well as conducting lab and field tests, flight evaluations, and iterative improvements based on test data. The UAV Engineer will prepare technical documentation, participate in design reviews, support troubleshooting and maintenance, and contribute to continuous enhancement of UAV architectures and ground control interfaces. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in aerospace, mechanical, or electronics engineering, with experience in UAV design, integration, and testing.
* Proficiency in CAD tools and structural analysis for airframe and mechanical component design, including materials selection and lightweight structures.
* Experience with avionics systems, sensors, GPS/INS, communication modules, and integration of flight controllers and autopilots.
* Knowledge of control systems, flight dynamics, and implementation or tuning of flight control algorithms (e.g., PID, navigation, stability augmentation).
* Hands-on skills in embedded systems, microcontrollers, and firmware development for UAV subsystems and interfaces.
* Familiarity with ground control station software, telemetry links, mission planning tools, and real-time monitoring of UAV operations.
* Experience with testing and validation, including bench testing, field trials, flight safety protocols, and data-driven performance optimization.
* Capability to work with cross-functional teams in AI, robotics, and sensor fusion, and to translate mission requirements into technical specifications.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics/Instrumentation,

title: Technical Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
Taxcart is a global tax engine that automates sales tax, VAT, and GST calculation within checkouts, invoices, and ERP systems. Through a single integration and transparent flat-rate pricing, it helps businesses streamline tax compliance across multiple countries. The platform ensures accurate tax application on every transaction, reducing manual effort and the risk of errors. Taxcart is designed for organizations that want to scale internationally while maintaining reliable and efficient tax processes.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time remote Technical Analyst role focuses on supporting and optimizing Taxcart’s tax engine integrations for customers worldwide. The Technical Analyst will analyze transaction data and system behavior, identify tax calculation issues, and recommend improvements to ensure accurate and consistent results. Daily tasks include troubleshooting technical problems, providing technical support to internal teams and clients, documenting findings, and collaborating with engineering and product teams to resolve incidents and enhance features. The role also involves interpreting business requirements, translating them into technical specifications, and contributing to process and workflow optimization to improve system performance and customer experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Technical Analysis and Analytical Skills to interpret data, diagnose system behavior, and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in Technical Support and Troubleshooting to resolve integration, configuration, and performance issues.
* Effective Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with APIs, SaaS platforms, or ERP/e-commerce integrations is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with tax domains such as sales tax, VAT, or GST, or a willingness to learn regulatory concepts quickly.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize effectively.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Background in data analysis tools, SQL, or scripting languages is a plus.
